mobbin:376a68ad-85c8-4071-a09d-bbfe73ce7.summary: User starts a Life Score test from 0/150, answers radio and multi-select items plus a frequency slider, then reviews a scored Weekly insights breakdown with retake.
steps: Life Score hub — 0/150 + Take the test
Strength slider — value 2–3 h / week + NEXT
Lower statuses — OFF-TRACK + Retake the test
steal: NEXT stays disabled until a choice is made (steps 2, 4) — forces complete rubric items.
Large full-row radio / multi-check targets (steps 2–5) — one-hand, gloved-friendly scoring.
Continuous slider with live value label for graded items (steps 6–7) — partial-credit analog.
Post-submit score gauge + grouped status cards OPTIMAL→OFF-TRACK (steps 8–11) — review after fill.
avoid: 41-step wizard for live scoring (step 6 shows 41/41) — too slow during a sim; keep rubrics short or sectioned.
mobbin:376a68ad-85c8-4071-a09d-bbfe73ce7.fit: Mobile one-question-at-a-time beats desktop forms for faculty filling a rubric live; extends Baseline checklist with big targets and scored summary — compress length for exam constraints.
